FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskY.en:
I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?
FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskY.fr: Je suis heureuse que tu sois là.\pJe commençais à en avoir assez de\nmarcher seule.\pTu me raccompagnes jusqu'à chez moi\n?

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDe.en: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.
FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDe.fr: Oh… J'avais peur que tu veuilles\nme faire du mal.

FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIn.en: W-what do you intend to do with\nme?
